metadata.record_policy: Imported seed DB. Published nutrition only when nutrition_source is published*; otherwise macros are estimated and labeled. Prices exclude tax/fees. Null means unknown.
metadata.nutrition_disclaimer: Nutrition is ESTIMATED unless nutrition_source = published_by_chain. Restaurants rarely publish full macros. Do NOT present estimates as medical or verified nutrition. For a demo, show nutrition_source + confidence to the user. Verify with the chain nutrition calculator / restaurant before any health claim.
metadata.price_disclaimer: Prices change and delivery prices differ from in-store. Fields carry price_source where known.
metadata.coverage_note: V6 audit (2026-11-15, after GK said dishes were missed and no restaurant should be missed): re-audited the USC Village OFFICIAL tenant directory (uscvillage.com/directory), Yelp's Top 10 near USC, Tripadvisor nearby lists, the RoamRecs USC guide and the Tuscany on Fig retail row. ADDED 12 restaurants: Gogobop Korean Rice Bar (Village directory - it now occupies Kobunga's old Suite 1610), Pete's Burgers (Hoover, since 1972), QWENCH Juice Bar & DRNK (Hoover), La Chuperia (Flower St), Tenori onigiri and HEYTEA and Cold Stone Creamery (Tuscany row), Azao Sushi (late-night, Figueroa), Tirebiter Brewery (Figueroa), Neighborhood Grill by Post & Beam and South LA Cafe (both inside the Natural History Museum), and Little Galen (USC Hospitality athletics dining, open to the public, not on the UPC View All list). STATUS CORRECTIONS: Little Pan USC is reported closed (2026) and replaced by Tenori at the same address - its entry is flagged, not deleted; Kobunga is flagged as possibly replaced by Gogobop; 'Fertitta Cafe' is the same place as Chad Tons Family Cafe (Fertitta Hall), already in the USC set - Chad Tons' dishes were expanded from USC's own Nov 5, 2026 video. CHECKED AND EXCLUDED, each verified 2026-11-15: Figueroa Philly (permanently closed per Yelp live data), Pizza Studio USC (permanently closed), AhiPoki Bowl Figueroa (no listing newer than its 2016 opening), Cafecito de la Crepe (real but 1.38 mi away, outside radius), 'Galen Thai' (no such restaurant exists near USC - guide error), the 358 W 38th St delivery-only ghost-kitchen brands (Tacos by Dres, Monty's, Vietnamese Delight, Pad Thai Diva - no storefront), Harold & Belle's / El Valle Oaxaqueno / El Mana / Johnny's Pastrami (all 1.9+ mi west). DISHES: menu pass added ~70 dishes with menu_evidence (official chain menus/apps, Toast and merchant-set delivery menus, a photographed July 2026 receipt at QWENCH, USC Campus Dining's Nov 2026 Chad Tons video, Viztango's Sep 2026 Tuesday-deal post, Tenori's Jul-Aug 2026 opening coverage). Remaining honest limits: rotating food trucks/stands are not enumerated; a few Village tenants still carry typical-hours flags; Dirt Dog's status conflicts; South LA Cafe (NHM) is lightly verified.
